entries.1b2548eff469507a: It sets its corporate philosophy as "Let us be a behind-the-scenes supporter of energy" and its base concept as "Energy saving for people, renewable energy for the people." Centered on the manufacture and sale of renewable energy electricity through woody biomass power generation using domestically produced wood chips as fuel, it sets as an important measure securing fuel stably during the period in which the sales method is guaranteed for 20 years from the start of power generation under the FIT and FIP systems. In addition, it has entered forest management, and while maintaining the cycle of planting, forest nurturing and material production, it seeks to secure profitability centered on mechanization.
